name: od-blender-to-artifact
title: Blender to artifact

title_i18n.ja: Blender からアーティファクトへ

description: Drive a local Blender session through MCP, render or export a still/scene asset, and wrap it as a live artifact in the project.

description_i18n.en: Drive a local Blender session through MCP, render or export a still/scene asset, and wrap it as a live artifact in the project.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 通过 MCP 驱动本机 Blender，渲染或导出静帧/场景资源，并包成项目里的 live artifact。

query.en: Use the connected Blender MCP server to build or adjust the scene for: {{prompt}}. Render or export a preview still, save it under the project media folder, and wrap it with a live artifact.
query.zh-CN: 用已连接的 Blender MCP 按以下需求搭建或调整场景：{{prompt}}。渲染或导出预览静帧，保存到项目 media 目录，并用 live artifact 包起来。
